Text: Work looks great for pulling context from multiple sources and shipping artifacts inside ChatGPT.

Grok Bot is a general purpose agent that can do anything you can on a computer.

Similar to Work, it has plugins / connectors, but it also has pretty insane remote computer use and the ability to run overnight.

I'd take a look at the X content bot example:

- Daily trigger
- Fetch X bookmarks with computer use via X dot com
- Draft a first prompt
- ask me for approval
- Trigger Cursor Cloud agent to build MVP
- Open the mvp and record a demo to verify the app works

Instacart / Amazon Delivery example:

- Specify my weekly grocery preferences
- Bot navigates two GUIs and assembles separate carts
- Bot compares prices, quantities, delivery costs
- Bot tells me when / where I should order from weekly

Bots can hand you the screen for login/2FA, keep working overnight on routines, and team up with other bots. 

For a really wild example, I had it run overnight and grind wii baseball on an emulator - it learned all the controls over the course of a few games and won

Hopefully that clears things up!
